workstreams.instruction: Construct the partition with exact coverage; prove sizes, colors, and noncrossing. Use canonical face representatives to avoid duplicate blocks.
Combine gluing with winning_restrict_heavy_face; include no-singleton hypothesis, empty skeleton and empty word.
Use certificate_pattern_determined_by_heavy_faces for injectivity and gluing for surjectivity. Quotient irrelevant list ordering.
State and prove both maps, inverse laws and binomial count.
Check Goulden-Jackson normalization from the primary source, class automorphisms, and coefficient extraction.
Freeze competing recurrence candidates before held-out tests; distinguish fixed-excess formulas from unrestricted b-ary enumeration.
